problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array

gfg.why: return all k largest; same heap

problems.gist: You get an integer array scores and an integer k. Return the k-th largest element of the array, meaning the element that would be at position k if the array were sorted in decreasing order. It is not the k-th distinct value: duplicates count separately.

problems.title: Merge k Sorted Lists

gfg.why: arrays instead of lists; same min-heap merge

problems.gist: A log collector receives k feeds. Each feed is a singly linked list of records, and the values (timestamps) in every feed are in ascending (non-decreasing) order. You are given the feeds as an array lists of list heads; a head may be null when a feed is empty.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.gist: You are given an integer array nums (think of it as a log of product ids, one per sale) and an integer k. Return the k values that occur most often in nums. You may return them in any order.

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.gist: A sensor sends integer readings one at a time. Build a class MedianFinder that can report the median of all readings received so far.

problems.title: Task Scheduler
problems.gist: You get an array tasks of jobs for one machine. Each job is an uppercase letter 'A' to 'Z' (its type). You also get an integer n. In each time unit the machine either runs one job or stays idle.

problems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.gist: You get an array points, where points[i] = [xi, yi] is a point on the plane, and an integer k. Return the k points nearest to the origin (0, 0), using Euclidean distance √(x² + y²). You may return them in any order. The answer is guaranteed to be unique (apart from order).

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
problems.gist: Design a class that reports the kth largest value of a stream of integers after each new value. "kth largest" counts duplicates (it is the kth element of the values sorted in descending order, not the kth distinct value).

problems.title: Reorganize String
problems.gist: You are given a string s. Reorder its characters so that no two adjacent characters are equal. Return any such arrangement. If no arrangement exists, return the empty string "".
